description: Owed by bedrock-q67.20.2: the bootstrap shard_key decode keeps a narrow binary_to_term(value, [:safe]) fallback (materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex decode_legacy_shard_tag) for clusters that wrote shard keys before Bedrock.SystemKeys.Values. RETIREMENT MECHANISM CHANGED by bedrock-q67.21.2 (2026-08-21): recovery no longer rewrites shard_keys/ for existing clusters (read-and-heal), so legacy values are NEVER re-encoded by recoveries — the original 'every completed recovery re-encodes; remove one release after 0.7' plan is dead. Retiring the fallback now requires an explicit one-time migration (a system transaction re-encoding legacy entries — natural home: the distributor's first ownership pass, or a dedicated migration step), after which the fallback and the adjacency reconstruction inside it can be deleted. A legacy family stays encoding-uniform meanwhile (nothing rewrites it), which the any-legacy-falls-back-whole rule covers.
title: Remove legacy term_to_binary shard-tag fallback from materializer bootstrap
